# Discovery call: Onyx Cloud (VP of Sales)

Context: 474 employees, just hired 6 SDRs, using Salesforce and Outreach.

> Our SDRs spend half the morning figuring out who to call and why.
> We have the tools, we just don't know which accounts are actually in market this week.
> Every new rep writes their own first line and half of them are generic.

Objection: already pays for an intent data tool.
> The intent data tells me a topic, not a reason to email someone today.

Outcome: trial on 2 SDRs, converted to annual.
